sections.description: Internal Kingdom tool for managing Sermons, Events, and Calendar views (with recurrence).
sections.changelog:
• Added single-date editing for recurring events, allowing users to edit one specific occurrence without changing the entire event series.
  • Added support for changing the date, time, and category of a single recurring event occurrence.
  • Improved the event editor UI to make adding and managing events feel less cluttered.
  • Minor fixes and refinements.
